sources.api_download_mechanism: Search API POST https://search.rcsb.org/rcsbsearch/v2/query; Data API REST/GraphQL; entry files https://files.rcsb.org/download/{id}.cif; biological assemblies https://files.rcsb.org/download/{id}-assembly{n}.cif; entity and chain FASTA at /fasta/entity/{id}_{entity}/download and /fasta/chain/{id}.{asym}/download
sources.release_version: Live archive; per-entry revision and initial release dates are read from mmCIF. API documentation last updated 2026-04-10; download documentation last updated 2026-02-10.
sources.license_usage_constraints: wwPDB archive coordinate/data files CC0 1.0; external integrated annotations retain provider-specific terms. Cite PDB ID and source publication where available.
sources.rate_limits: Static files not restricted; all APIs rate-limited. RCSB recommends starting at a handful of API requests per second and backing off on HTTP 429. CHIMERA default is 2 requests/second.
sources.identifier_scheme: PDB entry ID, polymer entity ID, label_asym_id, auth_asym_id, assembly ID
sources.chimera_use: Experimental structures, deposited polymer sequences, assembly files, revision metadata and ligand instances.
sources.checksum_policy: SHA-256 is computed locally. The individual-file endpoint does not provide a guaranteed authoritative expected digest, so checksum_verified remains false unless an expected digest is supplied from a pinned manifest.

sources.api_download_mechanism: Bulk mmCIF download https://files.wwpdb.org/pub/pdb/data/monomers/components.cif.gz; per-component mmCIF https://files.rcsb.org/ligands/download/{component_id}.cif; component metadata also appears in entry mmCIF chem_comp categories.
sources.release_version: Updated with weekly PDB releases; pin retrieved file checksum and component revision dates.
sources.license_usage_constraints: wwPDB archive data CC0 1.0; cite CCD/entry sources as appropriate.
sources.rate_limits: Static archive files; RCSB APIs remain subject to API rate limits.
sources.identifier_scheme: Three-character chemical component ID, parent component ID, CCD identifiers and descriptors
sources.chimera_use: Ligand names, formula, parent component, chemical identifiers and deposited ligand geometry. A CCD match alone does not establish biochemical substrate role.

sources.api_download_mechanism: REST API at https://rest.uniprot.org; entry JSON/FASTA at /uniprotkb/{accession}.json|.fasta; UniRef cluster JSON/FASTA at /uniref/{cluster_id}.json|.fasta; paginated search uses size/cursor and Link headers.
sources.release_version: UniProtKB 2026_03 released 2026-09-02; UniRef cluster IDs and membership are recomputed by release. Seed cluster UniRef90_P0C061 updated 2026-06-10.
sources.license_usage_constraints: CC BY 4.0 for copyrightable database content; some submitted records may have third-party rights. Attribute UniProt and check source record terms.
sources.rate_limits: No universal fixed limit asserted by current documentation; stream API can return HTTP 429 and is resource intensive. Use pagination and conservative serial requests. CHIMERA default is 1 request/second.
sources.identifier_scheme: UniProtKB accession, secondary accession, UniRef50/90/100 cluster ID, UniParc ID, taxonomy ID
sources.chimera_use: Sequence-derived structure linkage, taxonomy, reviewed NRPS features and UniRef90 homolog family for MSA generation.

sources.api_download_mechanism: REST API at https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/api; protein entry matches via /entry/interpro/protein/uniprot/{accession}/; Pfam profiles/models are available through Pfam FTP and InterPro API.
sources.release_version: InterPro 110.0 released 2026-09-03; Pfam member database 38.2 released 2026-03-26.
sources.license_usage_constraints: InterPro is distributed under EMBL-EBI terms; Pfam data are CC0 1.0. Preserve member-database/signature provenance and required attribution.
sources.rate_limits: No fixed request rate verified; use low-concurrency, cached API requests and respect service throttling.
sources.identifier_scheme: UniProt accession, InterPro accession, Pfam accession and signature accession
sources.chimera_use: Computed domain/family boundaries and domain-family leakage groups; predictions remain DATABASE_COMPUTED.

sources.api_download_mechanism: Versioned bulk downloads from https://mibig.secondarymetabolites.org/download; JSON cluster metadata, GenBank cluster records and protein FASTA. No general public record API or rate limit was verified.
sources.license_usage_constraints: CC BY 4.0; attribute the MIBiG project and original evidence/publications. Entry-level evidence must be retained.
sources.rate_limits: Bulk archive download; no public API rate limit verified.
sources.chimera_use: Curated BGC, product and experimentally supported cluster metadata; only map a BGC to a protein through sequence/accession evidence.
sources.implementation_status: JSON normalization adapter exists; no MIBiG record is associated with the controlled 1AMU seed in this dataset version.

sources.api_download_mechanism: Local antiSMASH command-line software and versioned result files are preferred for reproducible runs; inputs/outputs include GenBank and JSON. Public web submission is available but no bulk API was verified.
sources.release_version: 8.0 documentation is current in the official docs navigation; record the exact installed runtime version for each result.
sources.license_usage_constraints: Tool/runtime license is release-specific; documentation is CC BY 4.0. Preserve tool version, raw output and attribution.
sources.rate_limits: Public website is shared infrastructure; local installation is recommended for batch analyses. No numeric limit verified.
sources.identifier_scheme: Input sequence/record IDs, locus tags, region and module/domain feature IDs
sources.chimera_use: Computed BGC/domain/module/substrate-specificity calls. Never label predictions as experimental.
sources.implementation_status: GenBank result parser exists and is unit-tested; no antiSMASH result is associated with the controlled 1AMU seed in this dataset version.

sources.api_download_mechanism: PUG REST at https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug; bulk downloads are preferred for large requests.
sources.release_version: Continuously updated; pin retrieval timestamp and record identifiers.
sources.license_usage_constraints: NCBI does not impose restrictions on molecular data as a whole but submitter and third-party rights may apply; inspect record provenance and attribute sources.
sources.rate_limits: PUG REST usage policy asks for no more than 5 requests/second; dynamic throttling may apply.
sources.identifier_scheme: PubChem CID/SID, InChI, InChIKey, SMILES and source identifiers
sources.chimera_use: Optional chemical identity cross-reference after CCD component identity is established; never assign substrate by text-name matching alone.

sources.api_download_mechanism: EMBL-EBI downloads via https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/downloads; FULL/CORE/LITE OWL, OBO and OBO Graph JSON; flat files, SDF and SQL dumps. Monthly releases plus nightly ontology updates.
sources.release_version: Monthly release; exact current release identifier was not displayed on the verified downloads page. Pin downloaded snapshot and SHA-256.
sources.license_usage_constraints: EMBL-EBI terms of use apply; original contributed data may retain third-party rights. Attribute source records.
sources.rate_limits: Bulk downloads preferred; no numeric API limit verified.
sources.identifier_scheme: CHEBI numeric accession, secondary IDs, InChI/InChIKey and ontology relationships
sources.chimera_use: Optional ontology-backed substrate/ligand normalization after chemical identity is established.

sources.api_download_mechanism: E-utilities at https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils; FASTA, XML, GenBank flat files and FTP datasets.
sources.release_version: Record/retrieval timestamp and accession version; no single release pin for live E-utilities.
sources.license_usage_constraints: NCBI places no general restriction on molecular-data use but submitter/third-party claims may apply. Follow NCBI attribution and usage policies.
sources.rate_limits: NCBI scripting guidance: no more than 3 requests per second; provide a tool name and contact email for production automation.
sources.identifier_scheme: GenBank/RefSeq accession.version, protein accession, GeneID, TaxID, BioProject
sources.chimera_use: Optional nucleotide/protein accession fallback and BGC gene linkage; not the primary MSA provider for this seed.
